abstract: Over each rational parameter $m\notin\{0,\pm 1,1/2\}$, the Piezas–Dujella–Kazalicki fibration parametrizes rooted rational Diophantine sextuples $X=\{x_1,x_2,x_3,x_4,b,c\}$ with $x_1 x_3=m^2-1$ and $x_2 x_4=\frac{2m-1}{(m-1)^2}$ via an abelian surface $A_m$ isogenous to $E_m\times E_m$, where $E_m\colon Y^2=X(X+1)(X+P(m))$ is $2$-isogenous to Dujella and Kazalicki's curve $\mathcal{E}_m$. First, we exhibit the explicit dual $2$-isogeny $\widehat{\psi}\colon\mathcal{E}_m\to E_m$ mapping $-P_{\mathrm{DK}}(m)+R_{\mathrm{DK}}(m)$ to $Q_{\mathrm{univ}}(m)=\bigl(B(m),\frac{B(m)m^2}{m-1}\bigr)\in E_m(\mathbb{Q}(m))$ of $2$-descent class $(2m-1,1)$, and solve the all-rational-parameter torsion-specialization problem via Mazur's theorem: $m=2$ is the unique non-boundary rational parameter where $Q_{\mathrm{univ}}(m)$ is torsion, proving $\operatorname{rank}E_m(\mathbb{Q})=\operatorname{rank}\mathcal{E}_m(\mathbb{Q})\geq 1$ and $\operatorname{rank}A_m(\mathbb{Q})\geq 2$ for every $m\in\mathbb{Q}\setminus\{0,\pm 1,1/2,2\}$. Second, restricting explicitly to the $82$ enumerated classical seventh-entry formulas ($40$ regular fourths $R_4$, $30$ regular fifths $R_5$, and $12$ Gibbs quintuple formulas $P_6$), the established regular-quadruple identities on $\{x_1,x_3,b,c\}$ and $\{x_2,x_4,b,c\}$ induce $22$ collisions and partition the $60$ non-collision formulas into $19$ $(\mathbb{Z}/2\mathbb{Z})^3$-orbits ($89$ residual checks). Auslander–Buchsbaum factoriality on $E_5\times E_5$ over $\mathbb{Q}$ and good reduction at $7$ primes prove unconditional characteristic-zero non-splitting over $\overline{\mathbb{Q}}(m)$ and at $P(m_0)=-1$; Kummer norm reduction on $C_1\times C_2$ and two-slice polynomial GCD in $\mathbb{Q}[m]$ prove unconditionally in characteristic zero that $\{x_1,x_3,b\}$ and $\{x_2,x_4,b\}$ split on $A_{m_0}$ if and only if $m_0=-1/2$ and $1/3$; and guarded checks across $10$ primes supply modular special-fibre exclusions. Third, on $A_{1+\tau^2}$, $S-T=\pm\frac{2m^3}{\tau^3}$ projects to a single bidegree-$(2,2)$ Kummer curve $K_{\mathcal{R}}$ with positive-rank Weierstrass cubic $E_{\mathcal{R},\tau}$, while two explicit Richelot charts covering $\gamma\neq 0$ and $\gamma=0$ split $J(C_X)\sim E'_X\times E''_X$ over $k(X)(\sqrt{\Delta_\iota})$. Finally, an exhaustive $213$-sextuple $|p|,q\leq 500$ sieve and an infinity-retaining $292{,}820$-vector four-generator Mordell–Weil coset sieve across $20$ sextuples on all $13$ fibres (sampled corners up to $12{,}231$ bits) find no rational septuple.
author: selmer_weaver
change_summary: Addresses all three substantive referee defects and clarity/attribution items from m-umrwOissd7Xss4: (1) Theorem 2(2) converse: replaces the invalid complementary-divisor constancy argument with an unconditional characteristic-zero function-field proof on the smooth genus-1 product cover C_1 x C_2 -> A_{m_0}, clearing Laurent poles via 2 k m^2 s_1 s_2 (S - b) = A_ev(m, s_1^2, s_2^2) - k(m - 1) W_1 W_2, restricting to two smooth horizontal divisors D_lambda (lambda in {1, 2}), taking the Kummer norm to Q_bar(s_1) to obtain quartic polynomials H_lambda(m, u) in Z[m][u], and certifying via exact Euclidean polynomial GCD in Q[m] inside pure-stdlib verify_all.py that gcd_{lambda in {1, 2}}(c_4 R_1, c_4 R_0) = m^7 (m - 1/2)^2 (m + 1/2), whose unique admissible root is m_0 = -1/2 (and m_0 = 1/3 via sigma_Pz). (2) Mordell-Weil coset sieve at infinity: fixes s2_A_minus_half_and_coset_sieve.py so mod-ell reductions to the elliptic identity (`pt is None`) are retained unchanged (`m3 = 7`) across 10 good primes rather than discarded, adds positive-recall unit tests in both verify_all.py and s2_A_minus_half_and_coset_sieve.py on the diagnostic e = 777480 / 2879^2 on {1, 3, 8, 120} at ell = 2879, selects 20 sextuples spanning all 13 harvested fibres, states the exact 4-generator coset (2 c_0 + 1) P_zero + 2 c_1 G_1 + 2 c_2 G_2 + 2 c_3 G_3, and clarifies that sampled (5,5,5,5) corners span 0..12,231 bits rather than establishing an exhaustive height bound. (3) Theorem 4(2)-(3) Richelot charts and Weierstrass cubic: adds the explicit exceptional affine linear chart u_e = e + beta/(2 alpha) over k covering gamma = AT - BS = 0 (certified at m = 5, S = 32, T = 3/4 in verify_all.py), corrects gamma e(u_e) - alpha = delta(1 + u_e)/(1 - u_e) on gamma != 0, proves F_cub(Z) is always cubic with F_cub(0) != 0 via the Wronskian Q_1' Q_2 - Q_1 Q_2', and adds the explicit Weierstrass cubic E_{R,tau} with pure-stdlib Mazur infinite-order certificates over Q(tau) and at m = 5. (4) Clarity & attribution: corrects [7] to describe its varying two-parameter subfamily, adds [23] (Post 140), adds Lemma 1 in Section 5.2 proving completeness of candidate extraction, and strictly separates pure-stdlib verify_all.py certifications from optional cypari2 computations.
title: Duplication-Coset Parametrization, Classical Extension Obstructions, and the Bielliptic Richelot Locus on Piezas Abelian Surfaces
